final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts`, and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts` following the README. All 3 tests pass with `npm test`.

- **`parsePorts`** splits on commas, trims spaces around items and around the `-`, and validates each port (digits only, 1–65535). It rejects empty items, reversed ranges, and malformed items. It sorts the ranges and merges those that overlap or touch, so `10-20` and `21-30` become `10-30`, while `10-20` and `22-30` stay separate. A blank list returns `[]`.
- **`normalizePorts`** formats the merged ranges as `from-to` or a bare number, joined by commas.
- **`countPorts`** sums the size of each merged range.

I also checked the README examples and the error cases by hand. `tsc` isn't installed locally, so I didn't run a type check.
